plan.threshold_provenance: All thresholds below are proposed engineering decision rules, not observed effects or literature promises.
plan.baseline: R7b two TP1/DP4/EP4 engines, DSpark k5, API2 per replica, prefix cache enabled, seq128 override; verify actual runtime before any treatment.
freeze: image digest, exact source commits plus dirty diff hash
model/tokenizer revision and precision
effective launch args, visible GPU/rank mapping, router policy
trace hashes, arrival timestamps, exact custom length-aware scorer and AIPerf scorer versions
prompt-prefix identities and actual served token-weighted cache-hit measurements

metrics.primary: maximum sustainable SLO-qualified requests/s on identical offered-load traces, with non-growing queue and fixed error/SLO limits
metrics.cost: 8 GPUs at assumed $4.50/GPU-hour => $36/hour; $/M successful SLO requests=10000/goodput. Report scenario not bill; include measured router CPU resources separately.
latency: inter-token-gap percentiles separately by >=50-output and short-output cohorts
TPOT per request calculated separately; do not equate streamed chunk gaps to token execution latency
guardrails: queue growth slope and waiting-time tail
TTFT and E2E starvation by request length/prefix cohort

workload.closed_loop: agent-f75 8192 input/1024 output at concurrency256,384,512; report separately from open-loop
workload.open_loop: same Mooncake median/burst/cache-heavy traces at1,1.25,1.5,2x; if stable atceiling report right-censored capacity not maximum
workload.baseline_ceiling_warning: At1x R7b6.63goodput/6.65offered leaves no5%goodput headroom. Fixed-load wins must be latency/resource improvements; capacity claims require increased offered load.
workload.held_out: a different trace seed/time window plus prefix reuse0%,50%,75%target and skewed hot-prefix mixture; preserve actual observed hitrate

plan.statistics: Paired identical arrival/prompt seeds; randomize treatment order; 3repeats forscreening,5repeats only finalists. Use trace-block bootstrap95%CI on paired primary deltas, and latency quantiles with requestcounts. Keep timeout requests in denominators. No adaptive choosing winning seeds.

decision.support: At least5%increase in sustainable SLO goodput vs strongest static comparator with paired95%CI lower bound>0, without guardrail regression; OR atsame offeredload at least5%p95E2E reduction and throughput/error/correctness noninferiority.5%is a chosen threshold.
decision.reject: After prerequisite mechanism confirmed, no improvement beyond noise at strongest comparator, or sustained>=5%guardrail regression, starvation, correctness failure. Reject onlywithin declared scope.
decision.inconclusive: Baseline feature already enabled, absent prerequisite bottleneck, noisy baseline>5%CV, insufficient requests for tail, telemetry mismatch, or unreachable capacity knee.

plan.stop: Stop immediately on output correctness regression, OOM/repeated errors, unbounded queue growth, or p99TTFT>2x pairedbaseline for>60s. A crash is executionerror, not invalidation.
plan.title: Two-level engine-aware prefix affinity with load-skew escape
plan.hypothesis: If R7b wastes recoverable prefill because the external two-replica router and each DP4/API2 frontend do not preserve final-engine locality, routing on exact prefix identity through both levels with a queue-aware escape can raise SLO capacity. Endpoint stickiness alone is insufficient when internal rank assignment changes.
plan.source_grounding: PR43483 supplies opt-in internal DP prefix hashing and best-effort owner state; PR58757 describes per-engine consistent-hash routing. CacheRoute supports balancing reuse against skew and explicitly reports cases where more cache hits reduce capacity. None verifies current R7b deployment or B200 speedup.
plan.presence_gate: Inspect actual fixed latency router code and launch command, internal-DP policy, API2 process-shared owner state, rank-routing protocol and supported flags. Trace a repeatedprefix through endpoint->frontend PID->DP rank; measure servedcachehits. If policy already implemented, do notclaim activation asdelta; test bounded-load/hot-key escape separately.
implementation_surfaces: existing serving router request dispatch; exact file path requires runtimecheckout inspection
supported vLLM Router engine targeting; PR58757 is documentation, not implementationproof
plan.control: Original R7b routing plus best supported load-only least-work/power-of-two comparator; all engine configs fixed.
treatments: two-level affinity plus escape when predicted queuewait exceeds savedprefill time; start with bounded-load threshold calibrated onpilot, freeze beforeholdout
plan.causal_falsification: Atfixedofferedload affinity must increase actual reusedtokens or reduce executedprefill tokens; then examine whether queue skew erases benefit. If no recoverablemisses, stopbeforefullsweep. Do not optimize reportedcachehit alone.
instrumentation: prefix block hash inclmodel/tokenizer/adapter/cache-salt; hash no raw user content
frontend CPU overhead and telemetry staleness
plan.correctness: Treat routehash solelyas schedulinghint; engine verifies exacttoken-prefix cacheidentity. Include differenttenant salts/adapters/sameprefixtext and frontend restart/eviction tests. Avoid cross-tenant KV reuse; no token rewriting.
risks: two-level affinity can overload a rank while replica average looks balanced
endpoint affinity might regressdata-parallelbalance andexpert communication
plan.concrete_source_delta: At PR head b4baf2d, route() invokes _pick_balanced_miss_rank only inside _would_miss. Proposed adaptation tests queue-cost escape even for warm sticky hits, after measuring whether extra queue wait exceeds saved prefill time. Baseline router inclusion remains unknown.

reasons: required_improvement: The proposal gives a cheap inspection gate and a testable route to value. Its delta from the running baseline remains unknown because the effective router policy and rank targeting have not been inspected. The PR author describes a path that is “Disabled by default,” but that does not establish this deployment’s state.
Priority below this task's threshold; reconsider with evidence or a revised policy

plan.title: Pressure-adaptive prefill admission with bounded starvation
plan.hypothesis: If transient uncached prefills under the fixed16384 token budget cause decode interference on R7b, a cheap scheduler-state pressure controller limitingaggregateprefill work when decode isactive can improve SLOcapacity or tail latency. It must beat a properlytunedstatic2K/4K/8K/16K comparator and account for DSparkk5 multi-tokenprogress.
plan.source_grounding: RFC52906/P-PAS explicitly leaves globaltokenbudget unchanged while cappingaggregateprefillwork whenNp>=2 andNd>0; testedGPUs do notincludeB200. PR56848 documentsdecodecadence improvingdecodewhilehurtingprefill. SLOWeave explainsdeadline/cost-model approach but assumes oneprefillchunk anddoesnotmodelpreemption/KVtransfer.
plan.presence_gate: Inspect running scheduler, decode-priority/prefillscheduleinterval features, effective MBT, active requests and pressure-to-iterationtime correlation. Detect existingadaptivecontroller beforeport. Confirm which requestsarepuredecode underDSpark and whetherDP ranksmustcoordinate schedules.
implementation_surfaces: P-PAS repository https://github.com/TimoSaemann/ppas-vllm (vLLM0.22.1 report; sourcecompatibility notverified)
plan.control: R7b static16K plus strongeststaticbudget from2K/4K/8K/16K screening ontrainingtrace; keepseq128/DSpark/cache/routingfixed.
treatments: P-PAS lightweightcap:if>=2prefills pending/running andanydecode thenprefillcap2048 else16384; globalbudgetunchanged
optional secondphase deadline-predictor controller onlyifpressurecounterpilotworks; monotoneLUT calibratedforactualB200/DSparkbatchshapes
plan.causal_falsification: Measure decodeiterationtime conditionedonadmitteduncachedprefilltokens. If noburstinterference orcachehits eliminateprefillwork, prune. If adaptation onlytradesTTFTforITL withoutimprovinglength-awareSLOgoodput/E2E, reject.
plan.correctness: Schedulerchanges mustpreservecompletion/cancellation semantics and no starvation. Validategreedyoutput paritywithappropriatebatchnumericaltolerance, plusqualityregressiongate forsampling. CheckDP/EPcollectivealignment andKVallocationbeforefullrun.

reasons: required_improvement: The scheduler inspection gate and trace question give a credible testable path. Whether an adaptive admission policy is absent, or prefill interferes with decode on this deployment, remains unknown. The supplied E2E results do not settle either question.
